_note: measured act -> posture compatibility, from danbooru related_tag (which returns at most 500 rows, so an absent pose is bounded by 'floor', not zero). 'with' = pose tags that co-occur and how often; 'suppressed' = poses whose frequency with this act is below 0.25 of their mean across all measured acts, i.e. this act actively excludes them. An act with no row is unmeasured and therefore neutral.
